description: This file contains unit tests for thread-local storage functionality in the Starboard platform, including creation, destruction, and destructor behavior of thread-local keys and values.

classes.name: ThreadLocalValue
classes.description: Represents a thread-local value with a destroyed flag.

classes.name: Context
classes.description: Holds context information for thread-local storage operations, including key, input/output values, and destruction status.

methods.name: DestroyThreadLocalValue
methods.description: Destructor function that marks a ThreadLocalValue as destroyed.

methods.name: EntryPoint
methods.description: Thread entry function that sets and gets thread-local values, and checks destruction status.

methods.name: DoSunnyDayTest
methods.description: Performs a test with multiple threads to verify thread-local storage behavior with and without destructors.

methods.name: CreateTLSKey_NoRecycle
methods.description: Creates a thread-local key ensuring it is not recycled by the implementation.
